verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Pipedream MCP exposes pre-built, app-specific MCP servers for 3,000+ existing APIs with managed auth, but there is no documentation of a workflow to ingest a developer's own OpenAPI spec or custom code and auto-generate a hosted MCP server. The closest hint ('Or call any API from code') is unelaborated and not tied to MCP server creation. missing for 10: OpenAPI-spec-to-MCP-server generation feature, custom-code-to-hosted-MCP-server workflow, any docs describing developer-authored tool definitions being converted into an MCP endpoint.
